findings.text: non-blocking: _wait_no_reader_will_run returns None when a manifest declares only wait_condition, because _wait_probe_shape_refusal reads an absent probe as no refusal, so an ended worker on such a wait is still classed running with no duty even though its docstring at :1549 promises the declared wait nothing can probe.

non-blocking: _declared_wait_text scans only wait_probe and wait_file, so a refused manifest whose whole wait declaration is a prose wait_condition gets none of it into the refusal text, leaving the coordinator to repair the status and still not see the unprobeable condition.
